row.evidence: Every invisionapp.com URL, including /pricing, now 301-redirects to miro.com, and Miro's own page says InVision's "services shutting down", so there is no current plan or SCIM offer to score.
row.notes: New row. Discontinued product: on 2026-10-05 www.invisionapp.com, /pricing and /enterprise all 301-redirect to https://miro.com/ (support.invisionapp.com and developers.invisionapp.com returned no response). Miro bought InVision's Freehand app in November 2023, and Miro's InVision-alternatives page says InVision's services are shutting down. Microsoft's Entra tutorials are still published and describe a former InVision Enterprise SCIM 2.0 integration (SSO required first; create, update, remove users), but no first-party InVision page survives to confirm plans or prices. Okta's OIN 'InVision' app (last updated May 28 2019) is SWA only per page markup, so idp.okta is none. Recommend excluding this row at merge (as with almanac and delighted).

scim.notes: Not scored: the product is discontinued. Microsoft's Entra tutorial (still published) describes a former Enterprise-only SCIM 2.0 integration that required SSO first; no first-party InVision page survives to confirm it.

user_api.notes: invisionapp.com (including the developer and support sub-sites) no longer serves any InVision content.

okta.notes: OIN capabilities read from page markup: only SWA is marked (no SAML or SCIM); last updated May. 28 2019.

entra.notes: Gallery app with SSO and automatic provisioning per Microsoft's tutorials, which still say an InVision Enterprise account with SSO was required. The InVision service itself is discontinued, so the app can no longer be used; idp.entra left null in the row. built_by not stated.

fallbacks.notes: No InVision documentation survives on first-party domains; invisionapp.com redirects to miro.com.
